use_case_name: Clear Exercise Surveillance Data on an Exercise Status Order

claims.content: To rapidly clear the Exercise Indicator and all artificial data from exercise tracks upon receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 6) message.

goal.raw_text: To rapidly clear the Exercise Indicator and all artificial data from exercise tracks upon receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 6) message.

claims.content: C2 JU
A J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message has been received.
The receiving JU's database contains tracks with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1.
Receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message.

trigger.raw_text: Receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message.

claims.content: Automatically set the Identity Amplifying Descriptor to Exercise Friend.

Automatically set all data fields that may contain artificial information (as specified for each message in the appropriate paragraphs of this Volume) to the No Statement, default value, or actual values if held in database, and set the Exercise Indicator to value 0.
Break any locally originated engagement involving the TN by transmitting a J10.2 (WES = 8) message to report the engagement broken.

Terminate any locally originated Command message with Command values 2, 3, 5, or 7 involving the TN, by transmitting a J9.0 message with the Command field set to value 4, Cease Engage, or value 5, Hold Fire, if the Engagement Status field is set to value 4, Firing.

All data fields set to No Statement or default values, as specified in paragraph 4.7.1.6b(2), shall remain so set until an operator action is taken to change them or a remote report with the Exercise Indicator set to value 0 is received which changes them.

After receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 6) message, all subsequent messages received with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1 shall be discarded, and no messages with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1 shall be originated.
If for any reason, such as operator error, it is desired to change the simulation status of a track, the track shall be dropped using the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, and a new track shall be reported.
The one exception to this rule is that a change from live to simulated shall be accepted if the track is being received from an FJU.
The Exercise Indicator is set to value 0 for all tracks that previously had it set to value 1.
The Identity Amplifying Descriptor is automatically set to Exercise Friend for all affected tracks.
All data fields that may contain artificial information are set to No Statement, default value, or actual values if held in database.
Any locally originated engagement involving the TN is broken by transmitting a J10.2 (WES = 8) message to report the engagement broken.

Any locally originated Command message with Command values 2, 3, 5, or 7 involving the TN is terminated by transmitting a J9.0 message with Command field set to value 4 (Cease Engage) or value 5 (Hold Fire), if the Engagement Status field is set to value 4 (Firing).

All data fields set to No Statement or default values shall remain so set until an operator action changes them or a remote report with Exercise Indicator set to value 0 is received which changes them.

After receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 6) message, all subsequent messages received with Exercise Indicator set to value 1 shall be discarded, and no messages with Exercise Indicator set to value 1 shall be originated.
